_comment: Workbook exercise plant-chiller-multi (docs/workbook/plant-chiller-multi.md): the synthetic-chw-plant-multi plants (generated by CAMBER, no real building), each two chillers (CH1, CH2), a secondary loop (SECLOOP) and a tower (TOWER), at the trend's own 15-minute resolution and the rules' defaults: chw_supply_tracking (3 F above setpoint; warn 10 %, fault 25 % of running time), chiller_approach_fouling (5 / 4 F design; warn 1.5x, fault 2x), cooling_tower_approach (7 F design, judged at 90 % fan and above; warn 1.3x, fault 1.7x) and the tower drift family against the declared reference TOWER__well_run. chiller_staging_fleet runs here on purpose over the whole facility, to show that it pools every chiller it is given into one fleet on one clock (the 14 chillers of seven plants; the 7 secondary loops are left out, their power is the pumps'); the variants plant-chiller-multi--well-run, --over-staged and --near-miss run it on one plant's two chillers.
